cohort: 50 patients were recruited from the outpatient obstetrics clinics at Fayoum University Hospital, all of whom had previously undergone a caesarean section.
finding: The study found a strong, significant concordance between hysterosalpingography and hydrosonography in diagnosing uterine niche, and concluded that the caesarean section scar niche is unrelated to subfertility.
mod_finding: The myometrial defect known as the caesarean section scar niche was found to be unrelated to subfertility.
